title: Aspiring filmmaker here. I have a question.

commenti.body:
The only interest i have in the first one if whether or not there are three or four brothers in the car.

I do have interest in the second one, sounds really very interesting, but if it was pitched by the same person as the first one i would have concerns about their mastery of interpretation of poetry and how many liberties it may take with the source material, or how 'dude that is not what that meant' moments I would experience during watching.

The first one seems like if it had a great cast and the chemistry was on point, it could be a really moving picture, but i would suspect it would either be a love or hate it thing, and it will all come down to exactly how it plays out on screen.

The second one really has an interesting concept and depending on how it all played out it could be superb, but i would have concerns it would kinda end up like Sucker Punch, sure it looks great, and it occupies a couple hours so instead of pinnacle of cinematic achievement that i would be hoping for it is a colorful mess.... but i gotta watch it to find out whereas the brother movie... i already do not care and unless it was packed with my favorite actors, i honestly doubt i would give it a chance.

Why do you keep showing up here with these elevator pitches? I genuinely want to know because I see the same post in multiple subs with the same premises every week it seems. Bring us some pages next time maybe.
